name: Soul Element
details:
Grants a weapon the element of "Soul", granting a boost to your Attack Power and Mental Strength when your remaining HP is below 33%. However, this is ineffective with Techniques.

The stat increase percentage at each level of Soul is as follows:
Lv 1: 10%
Lv 2: 15%
Lv 3: 20%
Lv 4: 25%
Lv 5: 30%
